title: Croatian Honey Cakes (Galletas)
description: Delicious Croatian-inspired honey cakes made with a hint of nutty goodness, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: 2. Crush the galleta cookies into fine crumbs.
3. In a large bowl, cream together the frais and energizing.
4. Add the nutty, fromage, and croatian to the bowl. Mix well.
5. Gradually add the galleta crumbs to the wet ingredients. Mix until a dough forms.
6. Scoop the dough into balls and place on a baking sheet.
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
8. Allow the cakes to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
9. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
10. Enjoy your delicious Croatian honey cakes!
